title: fanoutqa: Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA? (0d90e4035372e84d)

chat_history.content: Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?

content.content: We need to answer: "Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?" Likely refers to career points leaders? Top 5 all-time scorers: (as of now 2025) Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (38,387), LeBron James (38,000+), Karl Malone (36,928), Kobe Bryant (33,643), Michael Jordan (32,292). Among those, who has the most MVP awards? MVP count: Kareem 6, LeBron 4, Karl Malone 2, Kobe 1, Michael Jordan 5. So Kareem has most MVPs (6). However, note that LeBron may surpass Kareem in points soon, but still top5 includes him. So answer: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Provide explanation.

content:
The player who has earned the most NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) awards among the league’s all‑time top‑5 scorers is **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar**.

| All‑time scoring rank (as of 2025) | Career points | MVP awards |
|-----------------------------------|--------------|------------|
| 1. Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar            | 38,387       | **6** (1971, 1972, 1974, 1976, 1977, 1980) |
| 2. LeBron James                   | ~38,000+     | 4 (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013) |
| 3. Karl Malone                    | 36,928       | 2 (1997, 1999) |
| 4. Kobe Bryant                    | 33,643       | 1 (2008) |
| 5. Michael Jordan                 | 32,292       | 5 (1988, 1991, 1992, 1996, 1998) |

Kareem’s six MVP trophies are the highest total among those five legendary scorers, making him the answer to the question.
